name: kernels-booking
title: Kernels: booking
description: Pure booking kernels from the Casa Exemplo redesign: ISO day arithmetic with no timezone drift, a rate card that keeps its provisional flags, quotes with every night, GST on its own line and the deposit, and availability with same-day turnover. No dependencies; runs in Node.

budget.reason: The five kernel files are 14,595 bytes; drift.test.js (2,389 bytes) ships with them so a consumer with its own copy can check it for drift, and it never loads in a page.
